explorationReceipt.approximateInspectedScope: Approximately 58 named tracks, releases and catalogue references across live September 9–11, 2026 Pitchfork and Resident Advisor feeds, TYGAPAW's 2026 Together You Gather All Power Applied Worldwide, µ-Ziq's 2024 Grush, and Gábor Lázár's 2020 Source and 2022 Boundary Object; attributed criticism and release metadata only; no audio audition.
exclusions: Run 153 Shackleton, Facta and Koreless decisions, unresolved identities and alternates were not recycled.

Recent Run 141–153 source families and current Bonobo, Argento, Bitchin Bajas, Booker Stardrum/Evan Shornstein, Nathan Fake and Placid Angles material already present in persistent history were excluded.
Tracks supported only by generic genre framing, prestige, process novelty or titles were inspected but excluded.
No Spotify connector, raw audio, audio-feature inference or invented identity was used.

OVERLOOKED CATALOGUE WINDOW: Gábor Lázár's 2020 Source and 2022 Boundary Object supply exact descriptions of contorting bass, mutated two-step, handclap returns and mounting/releasing pressure. https://pitchfork.com/reviews/albums/gabor-lazar-source/ https://pitchfork.com/reviews/albums/gabor-lazar-boundary-object/
